scale.h1: text-5xl md:text-6xl lg:text-[72px] font-bold tracking-tighter leading-[1.1] text-[#0A0A0A]

typography.pairing_justification: Outfit delivers a striking, geometric display aesthetic for high-end agency branding, while Inter provides sterile, high-legibility contrast for UI components like the prompt CTA and dashboard panels.

grids.hero: Single-column centered layout (max-w-4xl) to ensure tight typography and focus on the CTA.
grids.portal: Vertical stack with top-aligned tabs and a large 16:9 or 21:9 UI panel below. Center the tabs horizontally.
grids.footer: Standard multi-column grid for links, followed by a massive full-width container for the brand visual at the very bottom.

layouts.spacing_scale: Use 2-3x standard spacing. Apply py-24 or py-32 for section pacing. gap-8 and gap-12 for flex components.
layouts.hero_section: Generous vertical rhythm. Eyebrow -> H1 -> Subtitle -> Stat -> Prompt Box CTA.
layouts.portal_section: Max-w-6xl container. Ensure enough padding so the active tinted panel feels like a premium embedded product window.
layouts.glassy_brand_footer: Relative positioning with overflow-hidden on the footer container. The very bottom should feature the 8 brand stripes vertically, overlaid with a giant glassy text mask reading 'high on ai'.

nav.description: Sticky top navigation, backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/70, 1px bottom border border-black/5.

hero.description: Gushwork-style centered hero. Bold, minimal, grid-backed.
hero.elements: Eyebrow ('Full-Stack H.I.A.I. Engine'), Headline, Subtitle, Stat Callout.

prompt_box_cta.description: Clay.com style giant prompt input box.
prompt_box_cta.elements: White/Soft background box with heavy shadow-2xl, rounded-2xl. Rotating typewriter placeholder text. Quick-action chips (rounded-full). Submit button is a solid black circle with a white arrow.

services_portal.elements: Pill-shaped tab bar. Cycles between 4 services: GEO leads, AI videos, Voice AI, Hire fractional CXO. Cycles every 3s. The active tab and display panel are tinted utilizing different brand colors for each state.

faq.elements: Clean lines, 1px borders, bold question text.

visual_enhancers.grid_background: Implement a subtle grid background in the hero: background-image with repeating linear gradients (black/5), masked with a radial-gradient to fade at the edges.
visual_enhancers.color_infusion: Use the 8 vibrant brand colors strategically as accents (active chips, portal panel tints) against the stark white theme. Avoid muddy gradients.
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: For the bottom footer brand treatment, use backdrop-blur and partial opacity (bg-white/30) over the vibrant color stripes to create a premium glass effect.

motion.typewriter: Use an interval or typing animation library for the prompt box placeholder text.
motion.portal_cycling: Use Framer Motion AnimatePresence to smoothly crossfade the active portal panel and slide the active tab indicator every 3 seconds.
motion.interactions: Micro-animations on hover: buttons elevate (-translate-y-1) and shadows intensify.

seo_schema.organization: JSON-LD targeting QuantumAI OS Pvt Ltd and High On AI.
seo_schema.faq: JSON-LD FAQPage schema wrapping the semantic accordion.

accessibility.contrast: Maintain WCAG AA compliance. Dark text on light backgrounds. For CTA chips using brand colors, ensure text is readable (white on dark colors, black on light colors).
accessibility.motion: Respect prefers-reduced-motion for the automatic 3s cycling.

3d_libraries.framer_motion: Required for layout transitions in the portal tabs and prompt box animations.

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure 'Outfit' and 'Inter' fonts are loaded via Google Fonts or standard imports.
Set up Tailwind configuration to include the 8 custom brand colors under a 'brand' object.
Construct the Hero section using a Gushwork-inspired centered aesthetic with a subtle technical grid background.
Build the Prompt Box CTA mirroring Clay.com's aesthetic: large rounded input, quick-action chips underneath, and a black arrow submit button. Incorporate a typing effect for the placeholder.

Develop the Services Portal component. Create an automated cycle (0 to 3) running every 3 seconds to switch active tabs. Sync this state to display corresponding content in the main glass-tinted UI panel below. Animate state changes smoothly.
Integrate the 8 brand stripes directly into the bottom-most footer section, overlaid by a giant, partially transparent 'high on ai' text or SVG.
Implement structured JSON-LD schemas (FAQPage and Organization) in the document head.
Ensure the final aesthetic feels premium, high-end, and starkly distinct from generic dark-mode AI templates.
universal_guidelines_for_main_agent: Strictly adhere to a White/Light theme; dark mode is strictly forbidden.
Include 'data-testid' attributes on all interactive elements (buttons, links, inputs).
Apply 2-3x standard spacing to create a luxurious, premium layout.
Use proper semantic HTML elements (section, nav, main, footer).
Left-align standard body text for readability, reserving centered alignment for hero headings or specific focal points.
Do not use generic placeholder image services; utilize the provided Unsplash URLs or generic CSS gradients/abstract shapes tinted with brand colors.
